hero.headline: Authentic Punjabi Flavors at Ff 102
hero.subheadline: From our kitchen in Bodakdev to your table, we bring generations of traditional Punjabi recipes alive. Every bite tells a story of heritage, warmth, and the rich spices that make Punjab unforgettable.

about.title: Our Journey from Punjab to Ff 102
about.story: At EAT PUNJAB, we've transformed our cozy corner at Ff 102 into a gateway to authentic Punjab. Our chefs carry forward time-honored recipes, using traditional techniques and fresh spices that transport you straight to the heart of Punjab. Located conveniently opposite Himalaya Mall on Gurukul Road, we've become Bodakdev's go-to destination for families craving genuine Punjabi hospitality. Every dish we serve reflects our deep respect for Punjabi culinary traditions.

services.title: How We Serve Punjab on a Plate

items.title: Dine-In Experience
items.description: Settle into our warm, welcoming space where the aroma of fresh rotis and sizzling tandoor fills the air. Perfect for family gatherings and celebrations.

items.title: Takeaway & Delivery
items.description: Enjoy our authentic flavors at home with carefully packed meals that retain their warmth and taste. Quick pickup from Ff 102 or delivery to your doorstep.

items.title: Catering Services
items.description: Bring the taste of Punjab to your special occasions. We handle everything from intimate family dinners to large celebrations with authentic flair.

items.title: Tiffin Services
items.description: Regular home-cooked Punjabi meals delivered fresh to your office or home. Like having a Punjabi kitchen without the cooking.

items.title: Family-Friendly Dining
items.description: Spacious seating and kid-friendly options make us perfect for multi-generation family meals. High chairs and patient service included.

items.title: Vegetarian Specialties
items.description: Extensive pure-veg menu featuring dal makhani, paneer dishes, and seasonal vegetables prepared with ghee and love.

items.name: Rajesh Patel
items.text: The butter chicken here reminds me of my trips to Amritsar. Authentic taste and the naans are perfectly soft. My family's new favorite spot in Bodakdev.

items.name: Priya Sharma
items.text: Finally found a place that makes proper dal makhani! The rich, creamy texture and overnight slow-cooking really shows. Worth the drive from anywhere in Ahmedabad.

items.name: Vikram Singh
items.text: As someone from Punjab, I'm picky about authentic taste. EAT PUNJAB gets it right - from the tandoor roti to the perfectly spiced chole. Feels like home.

items.question: Do you serve authentic Punjabi-style tandoor items?
items.answer: Yes! We have a traditional clay tandoor where we bake fresh naans, rotis, and tandoori items daily. You can even watch our chefs at work.

items.question: Is parking available near Ff 102 location?
items.answer: Absolutely. Shilp Square has ample parking space, and being opposite Himalaya Mall, you'll find convenient parking options for dining with us.

items.question: Can you accommodate large family gatherings?
items.answer: We love hosting families! Our spacious dining area can accommodate groups, and we offer special family platters. For larger parties, our catering service works perfectly.

items.question: Do you offer pure vegetarian options?
items.answer: Yes, we have an extensive vegetarian menu with traditional dishes like dal makhani, paneer specialties, and seasonal vegetable curries - all prepared in separate cooking areas.

items.question: How spicy is your food, and can you adjust the heat level?
items.answer: Our chefs can adjust spice levels to your preference. We mark spice levels on our menu and always ask about your heat tolerance when you order.

items.question: What are your most popular dishes at EAT PUNJAB?
items.answer: Our butter chicken, dal makhani, fresh tandoor naans, and creamy lassi are customer favorites. The mixed vegetable curry and chole bhature are also highly recommended.
